exhaustivenessReason: the three unordered pairings of two external fermions and two external scalars give two Yukawa-Yukawa fermion exchanges and one Yukawa-cubic scalar exchange

protectionCriterion.meaning: the central incidence mask must forbid at least one renormalizable vertex in each of the three mediator topologies

junkBoundary: integrating out a propagating mediator produces a Schur-complement Wilson coefficient; this is not a represented degree-two differential form and is not removed by the ordinary junk quotient
verdict: UV exactness is equivalent, at one-mediator tree level, to a three-topology portal veto rather than to charge conservation alone
